projects.name: Productiv - Rails Productivity Platform
projects.context: Ruby on Rails 8, PostgreSQL | Genesys team project
bullets: Year 4 team project: a productivity platform with personal/shared tasks, team projects, Pomodoro, notifications, gamification and role-based analytics.
The team codebase includes RSpec/Capybara tests, performance examples and CI configuration for testing, security and linting.

projects.name: ReCoLA - Android Property Management
projects.context: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, Google Maps | Six-person team
bullets: Implemented property creation, viewing, editing and deletion, maps/geocoding, proximity sorting, supplier assignment, internal image handling and related tests.
Connected Compose screens to Room persistence and map/list navigation, with alphabetical sorting when live location was unavailable.

projects.name: TB-Turing / HeAR - Audio-Based TB Screening Research
projects.context: Python, PyTorch, Google HeAR, HPC | HeAR workstream within team research
bullets: Developed patient-level multiple-instance learning over frozen HeAR cough embeddings, with grouped five-fold cross-validation, sensitivity-targeted thresholds and bootstrap analysis.
The DS2 symptom-assisted configuration reached 0.830 AUROC in retrospective internal cross-validation; this was screening research, not clinical validation.

projects.name: Parallel Computing with OpenMP and CUDA
projects.context: C/C++, CUDA, OpenMP, Nsight | Individual coursework
bullets: Implemented and optimised Count Gliders, Histogram and Emboss in OpenMP and CUDA against supplied serial CPU references.
Checked correctness and profiled execution with Nsight; compared end-to-end timings including allocation, host-device transfers, kernel execution and cleanup.

projects.name: Heston Option Pricing and Calibration
projects.context: Python, NumPy/CuPy, PyTorch, SciPy | Individual dissertation
bullets: Implemented CPU COS pricing, batched CuPy GPU pricing and bounded L-BFGS-B calibration of the Heston stochastic-volatility model to filtered SPX option contracts.
Trained a ten-feature PyTorch surrogate on 600,000 synthetic samples and compared calibration runtime and pricing error across CPU, GPU and surrogate paths.

projects.name: Speech Technology - Neural VAD and GMM Modelling
bullets: Compared MLP, recurrent and temporal-convolutional voice-activity detectors; the selected TCN achieved 7.73% EER over 495,486 cross-corpus test frames.
Separately implemented Gaussian mixture models for vowel classification and closed-set speaker identification, comparing mixture complexity and utterance-level decisions.
